summary.en: An interface block hung on the thread by a hook: a warm off-white paper block (a chat with bubbles, a task row with its running ring, the closing panel with one "needs you") or a glass card on the night; it unfolds from its left edge along the hook and turns done.
summary.zh: 用挂钩挂在线上的界面块：暖白纸块（带气泡的对话、带进度环的任务行、只有一处“需要你”的收尾面板）或夜空上的玻璃卡；从左边沿着挂钩展开，完成时变成勾。

fits: Showing an agent's interface as small pieces on the night: chat, a task, a summary card, a status panel.
notFor: A full-screen app screenshot; long documents; more than three rows a block.

intent.en: Show the interface as small objects the thread holds, never as a screen that fills the frame.
intent.zh: 把界面做成线挂着的小物件，而不是铺满画面的一整屏。

content.en: A chat (1–3 bubbles), a task row (title, running and done lines), a glass card (title and up to three rows) or a panel with one row that needs the user; the panel optionally with tabs, a group header and row times; "needs you" in the warn role.
content.zh: 一段对话（1–3 个气泡）、一条任务行（标题、进行中与完成两行）、一张玻璃卡（标题和最多三行）或只有一行需要用户的面板；面板可选页签、分组标题和行尾时间；“需要你”用 warn 角色。

fits.zh: 把 agent 的界面拆成夜空上的小块：对话、任务、摘要卡、状态面板。

notFor.zh: 整屏的应用截图；长文档；一块超过三行。

pairs.note: how it can leave: folded into the line

en: Keep sky around it: a block wider than about half the frame stops reading as hung on the thread.
"Needs you" is the warn role and appears once (accentInk unless the film sets warn); the running ring stays accentInk; a done row is a neutral tick.
zh: 四周要留出夜空：块宽过画面一半左右，就不再像挂在线上。
“需要你”用 warn 角色、只出现一次（影片不设 warn 时同 accentInk）；进行中的转圈仍是 accentInk；完成的行是中性的勾。
